description: Account profile folders (ADR-0191 D1, ADR-0190 D3-f, #2878): list, create, status and the guarded removal of `~/Library/Application Support/oort/profiles/<harness>/<label>/`. The webview names a harness and a label only; the shell decides and checks the folder, and removes one only after the official CLI reports it signed out. For the main window's own webview (label `main`) on the bundled (local) origin only, scoped by webview like pty.json. No `remote` entry: a page from the network must never create or remove a profile.
